name: Dumitru's Visitor
summary: Dumitru waits inside Krezk's gate for a visitor who never comes, and writes weekly letters to an uncle in Vallaki who died.

stages.journal: Dumitru waits inside Krezk's gate every day for a visitor, and writes weekly letters to his Uncle Marius in Vallaki, who died long ago. He keeps them in a tin. Nobody ever comes up the road for him.
objectives: Give Dumitru a visitor: come as his uncle's friends, or bring someone up the road
stages.hint: Talk to Dumitru inside the gate at Krezk. A travel writer at the Old Svalich crossroads might walk up the road for him.

stages.journal: Ambrose Fennimore, the travel writer at the Old Svalich crossroads, has agreed to walk up to Krezk and visit Dumitru.
objectives: Meet Fennimore and Dumitru inside the gate at Krezk
stages.hint: Go to Krezk and meet Fennimore and Dumitru inside the gate.

stages.journal: Dumitru has had a visitor. He will write to say so.
